status: a new lower bound (previous: 99, from the 98-point colouring of arXiv:2611.25143; survey: 88)
indexing: points are 0..99; character i (from 0) of 'colouring' is the colour of the i-th 3-subset in lexicographic order, the order of Python's itertools.combinations(range(100), 3)

rule.maps: x -> g*x + b (mod 100) for b in 0..99 and g in the group generated by the multipliers
